string-array.item: SOS actions follow your saved consent settings. Fall monitoring and spoken reminders are opt-in.
Review Android access and current status
Profile details are stored on this device.
Your reminder will stay active until you choose an action.
Scheduled reminders you create in MedMitra
Add a medicine and its daily reminder time.
Reminders are stored on this device. Android may delay them when exact alarm access is off or battery restrictions are active.
Exact access is off; reminders may be delayed

Alarm sound and optional speech repeat until you choose Taken or Snooze. Snooze is 5 minutes. When the phone is locked, Android can open the full-screen alarm if notifications, High channel importance, and full-screen access are enabled. When the phone is unlocked, Android 13 and later show an expanded alarm notification instead of taking over another app; this is enforced by Android.
Full-screen alarm unavailable: notifications are disabled.
Full-screen access is off. Android will keep the notification as fallback.
Medicine notification channel is below High importance.
Ready for automatic full-screen launch on the lock screen. While the phone is unlocked, Android may show the expanded notification instead.

Samsung phones: if alarms are delayed or suppressed, set MedMitra to Unrestricted under Settings → Apps → MedMitra → Battery, and add it to Never sleeping apps under Battery → Background usage limits. Menu names vary by One UI version. The full-screen setting is under Settings → Apps → Special access → Full screen alerts (or Full screen intents).
It's time to take your medicine.
Speech starts when you preview a message.
Enter a message for Android Text to Speech to read aloud. This does not record your voice.
Speech could not start. Check the installed speech engine and language data.
When enabled, the saved message is spoken when a scheduled medicine reminder fires. Android may limit speech when the app is in the background or another audio session is active.
No speech data installer is available.
Review what MedMitra uses. You can skip any item and change access later in Android Settings.
Show scheduled reminders and alarm controls.
Lets medicine reminders fire close to their scheduled time.
Not required on this Android version
Allows a medicine alarm to take over the screen when Android permits it, such as while locked.
These permissions are used only for actions you enable and explicitly start in SOS. This checklist never sends a message or places a call.
Adds a current location to an SOS message when a fresh fix is available.
Needed only if you enable automatic SOS text messages to your saved trusted contact.
Needed only if you enable automatic SOS calling to your saved trusted contact.
Lets the opt-in Fall Safety foreground service use motion activity on Android 10 and later.
Trusted contacts are entered in MedMitra; the device address book is not read.
Spoken reminders use Android Text-to-Speech and do not record audio.
If Android no longer shows a permission prompt, open Settings → Apps → MedMitra → Permissions. Special alarm access opens its own Android settings page. Status updates when you return.
Personalize reminders and trusted contacts. Your details stay on this device.
Only save this person as a trusted contact if they have agreed to receive emergency messages or calls.
I have consent to save and contact this person
Enter a valid international phone number or leave the number blank.
Enter the contact name and phone number, or leave contact consent off.
Could not save your profile. Your existing data has not been cleared.
Add a trusted person before using the SOS flow.
Contacts and emergency-action preferences stay on this device. Automatic SMS or calling can contact people without another confirmation after the SOS countdown.
Send SMS automatically after SOS countdown
Call selected contact automatically after SOS countdown
Include a fresh location in emergency SMS when available

Automatic SMS requires Android SEND_SMS access, cellular service, and an active subscription. Google Play requires approval for its physical-safety SMS exception; without approval, use the SMS app fallback. A successful send request does not prove delivery. Direct calls start without another confirmation and cannot be verified as connected.
All permissions selected in setup are currently granted.
Grant location access to safely test a location fix. No SMS or calls were made.
Checking a fresh location. No SMS or calls will be made.
No fresh location was available. Check location services and network. No SMS or calls were made.
Use your phone's emergency number for immediate danger. This SOS contacts the trusted person selected below.
No enabled trusted contact. Add one in Emergency Contacts.
On when permission and a fresh fix are available
Press only when you want to contact your selected trusted person. Nothing starts until you press SOS.
SOS cancelled. No emergency actions were attempted.
SMS app opened. Review and send the message there.
No compatible SMS app is available.
Open SMS app to send manually
Phone dialer opened. Confirm the call there.
No compatible phone dialer is available.
Actions start when the countdown ends
SOS cancelled. No SMS, call, or location request was made.
Emergency actions were attempted. SMS delivery and call connection cannot be confirmed here.
Activity recognition permission is needed to start the health foreground service.
Enable notifications before starting visible fall monitoring.
Requesting a safe demo alert. No SMS or call will be made.
Android could not start the demo foreground service.
Active while its ongoing notification is present
Previously enabled; service stopped. Restart manually.
Enable notifications before testing the alert.
Send a sample fall alert to this device only. No SMS or calls will be made.
Monitoring is opt-in and uses a motion heuristic. It can miss falls or flag ordinary movement; it is not medical-grade and cannot replace emergency services.
Android may ask for Activity Recognition permission to run this health foreground service. Sensor readings stay on this device.

Start monitoring while this screen is visible. Android keeps it in a foreground service with a permanent notification. MedMitra does not restart sensor monitoring after reboot; turn it on again after a restart.
Accelerometer, gyroscope, and fused orientation data are processed locally when those sensors are available. MedMitra does not request background location or body-sensor access for this feature.
Battery optimization: Android or the phone maker may pause the service under heavy restrictions. Review system battery settings if monitoring stops.
Lower sensitivity reduces false alarms but may miss events. Higher sensitivity may trigger more often. New settings apply immediately if monitoring is active.
A motion candidate shows a notification with an “I’m okay” cancel action. If it expires, MedMitra records it and offers SOS. It never sends a message or places a call automatically.
No accelerometer is available on this device.
Motion is monitored on this device. Tap to manage.
Demo only. No SMS or call was made.
No response was received. No call or message was sent; open SOS if you need help.
Permission results saved by Android. Review the current access below.
No requested permissions were granted. Automatic actions will be unavailable until enabled in Android Settings.
SMS could not be sent because cellular service is unavailable.
SMS could not be sent because the cellular radio is off.
Android reported that the SMS could not be sent. Use the messaging fallback below.
Add and enable a valid trusted contact before starting SOS.
No actions were attempted because the history save exceeded the countdown window
SOS was cancelled because its history could not be saved. No contact action was attempted.
No emergency action was attempted because the selected contact or history record is unavailable.
I need help. Please contact me.
Submitted to Android; delivery not confirmed
Failed to submit; use fallback below
Could not start; use fallback below
One or more configured actions could not start. Check permission, SIM/service, and fallback options below.
Start SOS with a five second cancellation countdown
Fall monitoring stopped during the alert
Safe demo alert; no emergency action was started
Possible fall detected; no emergency action has been started
Alert acknowledged before history save completed
Safe demo ended; no call or message was sent
No response to fall alert; no call or message was sent
Starting foreground monitoring. The active state will appear after the service registers its sensors.
Android blocked fall monitoring. Check notification and activity permissions, then try again.
Fall monitoring can only start while MedMitra is visible. Return to this screen and try again.
Activity Recognition permission is required for the health foreground service.
Enable notifications, return here, then turn monitoring on.
Enable notifications before testing the alert.
I have consent to save and contact this person
Cancelled during countdown; no SMS or call attempted
User acknowledged the possible fall alert

A motion candidate shows a notification with an “I’m okay” cancel action. The selected countdown gives you time to cancel a false alarm. If it expires, MedMitra records the event and offers SOS. It never sends a message or places a call automatically.
